topic: Handling frame dimensions and visibility calculations
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the precision of stored frame dimensions (width/height) in the system, noting that these values are stored as JSON data and sometimes contain high decimal precision. A key point was raised regarding how changes to width or height affect `max_visibility_distance`. It was clarified that while changing the dimension might trigger a recalculation prompt, the current process seems to be designed so that manual input of dimensions (e.g., increasing height by 1 meter) will initiate a calculation check, which can then be overridden.

It was noted that the system does not automatically apply formulas during import when updating width/height.
decisions: The system should prompt the user to recalculate visibility distance when manually changing frame height or width.
